payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance improvements of the model over state-of-the-art systems, including percentage increases in F1-scores for various discourse relations.

claims.text: The model outperforms previous state-of-the-art systems on the benchmark corpus of PDTB.
The model improved the macro-average F1-score by over 7 percent compared to the baseline Bi-LSTM model.
The model achieved clear performance gains of around 2 and 8 percent on contingency and temporal relations respectively compared to the baseline Bi-LSTM model with tensor.
The basic paragraph-level model further improved classification performance on the first three implicit relations by an additional 1.42 percent on the contingency relation.
